acip: MA GRUB NA, BUM PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD DNGOS PO'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD DNGOS PO YIN KHYOD DNGOS PO DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING DNGOS PO YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, bum pa chos can, khyod dngos po'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod dngos po yin khyod dngos po dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing dngos po yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that a coffee cup would be characteristic of working thing. If you do disagree, then let's consider a coffee cup. It is too characteristic of working thing, Because (1) a coffee cup is a working thing; (2) it shares a relationship with working thing such that to be it—the coffee cup—is to be a working thing; and (3) there do exist many examples of other things which are not coffee cups but which are still working things.
